item.title: India's rice exports jump 19.4 pc after curbs lifted
item.description: India's rice exports surged 19.4 per cent last year, reaching the second-highest level on record after the government lifted all export restrictions. The move boosted India's competitiveness, reinforced its position as the world's largest rice exporter, and led to increased global supply, pushing Asian rice prices to their lowest in nearly a decade. The price drop has benefited poorer importing nations, particularly in Africa

item.title: 'Reflects Himanta Biswa Sarma's Pakistani thinking', Owaisi hits out at 'Hindu PM' remark
item.description: AIMIM chief Asaduddin Owaisi criticised Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma for suggesting that India's Prime Minister would always come from a Hindu civilisational framework, calling the remark reflective of "Pakistani thinking" and unconstitutional. item.title: Nupur Sanon and Stebin Ben lock lips, celebrate love in fairy tale Christian wedding, say 'I do, always and forever'
item.description: Nupur Sanon and Stebin Ben are now officially husband and wife. The couple tied the knot in a Christian ceremony on Saturday, surrounded by close friends and family. For the Christian ceremony, Nupur looked stunning in a classic off-shoulder white wedding gown, paired with a veil neatly styled over her bun, radiating elegance and grace. Stebin complemented her perfectly in an off-white tuxedo jacket with a black lapel and bow tie.

item.title: Authorities rush to contain gastroenteritis outbreak in Jammu's Jagti, Nagrota migrant camps
item.description: A health alert has been sounded in Jammu after several cases of gastroenteritis were reported from the Jagti and Nagrota migrant camps. The administration has ordered immediate testing of water samples and asked the Health Department to issue preventive advisories.

item.title: MCX silver may hit Rs 3.2 lakh in 2026: Motilal Oswal
item.description: Motilal Oswal expects MCX silver prices to continue their strong rally in 2026, projecting a target of Rs 3.20 lakh per kg, implying nearly 27 per cent upside from current levels. After surging 170 per cent in 2025 and outperforming gold, silver's rise has been driven by geopolitical tensions, trade uncertainties, easier monetary policies, strong ETF inflows, supply constraints and robust safe-haven demand. item.title: BJP no alternative to Congress in Telangana, says KTR
item.description: KTR criticised the Congress government's 24-month tenure as a period of administrative failure, unfulfilled promises, corruption, and betrayal of public trust, particularly on issues such as Krishna River water sharing. He accused both national parties of acting against Telangana's interests and said people are increasingly dissatisfied with Congress rule.

item.title: India vs New Zealand, 1st ODI: Virat Kohli falls short of century with 93, KL Rahul guides thrilling win for India
item.description: In the 1st ODI between India and New Zealand at Kotambi International Stadium, India chased down a target of 301 to win by four wickets and take a 1-0 lead in the three-match series. Virat Kohli scored a brilliant 93, falling just short of a century, while Shubman Gill contributed 56.

item.title: Sextortion scams surge in J&K, police sound high alert
item.description: With sextortion cases rising sharply across Jammu and Kashmir, police have issued a high alert, warning people against online blackmail traps using fake social media profiles and video calls. Victims are urged not to panic or pay money, but to immediately report incidents and preserve digital evidence.

item.title: Virat Kohli surpasses Sangakkara, becomes second-highest run-scorer of all time
item.description: Virat Kohli surpassed Sri Lankan great Kumar Sangakkara to become the second-highest run-scorer in international cricket during the first ODI against New Zealand in Vadodara. Kohli crossed 28,016 runs, moving past Sangakkara and trailing only Sachin Tendulkar, who remains the leading run-getter of all time. item.title: Disha Patani sizzles in blue bodycon, gets cosy with Mouni Roy at Nupur Sanon–Stebin Ben wedding
item.description: Mouni Roy shared a series of photos with her husband and best friend Disha Patani from the wedding celebrations, but netizens mocked her husband Suraj, calling him a third wheel in Mouni and Disha's close friendship and claiming the duo shares better chemistry.
